# dremio_role (Resource)

Role in the experimental Dremio OSS RBAC fork. Requires initialized OSS management API and an active ADMIN caller. Not compatible with the Enterprise Roles API. System roles may be imported for observation but cannot be created or destroyed. Deletion refuses memberships, grants and owned objects; remove or transfer them explicitly first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Experimental OSS RBAC fork only. Bootstrap an active ADMIN explicitly first.
# Existing roles must be imported by stable ID, never adopted by name.
resource "dremio_role" "read_only" {
  name = "ReadOnly"

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "dremio_role" "analyst" {
  name = "Analyst"

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Memberships and privileges are not part of these resources.
# Do not add this example to production before the OSS API is deployed/accepted.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name. Rename is unsupported and requires replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable server-generated role ID; import by this ID, not by name.
- `tag` (String) Observed global policy OCC version; not an Enterprise role version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Substitute the stable ID returned by the OSS role collection API.
tofu import dremio_role.read_only '<stable-role-id>'
```
